title: Population ageing and inpatient care for neurosurgically relevant conditions in Germany to 2040: age-structured versus population-based projections: analysis code
description:
Analysis code and documentation for the study "Population ageing and inpatient care for neurosurgically relevant conditions in Germany to 2040: age-structured versus population-based projections".

The pipeline (Python) reconstructs the analysis from published aggregate statistics of the Federal Statistical Office of Germany (GENESIS-Online): hospital discharges by principal diagnosis (ICD-10-GM C70–C72, D32, D33, G91, I60, I61, I62, S06), inpatient procedures (OPS 5-013, 5-015, 5-022, 5-023), observed populations and the 16th coordinated population projection. It compares population-based and age-structured projections of inpatient care to 2040, nationally and for the 16 federal states, decomposes projected and past change, and evaluates both approaches in rolling-origin backtests. Source data are not included; data/README.md describes how to obtain them, with checksums of the files used.
